t: I look forward to hearing from you.
d: お返事をお待ちしております。
x: 〔look forward to の後は名詞か ~ing。to hear としないのがポイント。your reply / your response も可（your が要る）。I'm waiting for your reply. は文法は正しいが催促に聞こえやすいので、メールの結びには向かない。メールの結びの定番〕
p: {I look|I'm looking} forward to {hearing from you|your reply|your response}{| soon}.
o: I'm looking forward to your reply.

d: 会議は3時に始まります。
x: 〔決まっている予定は現在形で言える。at + 時刻〕
p: The meeting {starts|begins|will start|will begin|is going to start} at {three|3|3:00|three o'clock|3 o'clock|3 pm|3 p.m.}.
o: The meeting will begin at 3:00.

t: Could you send me the documents?
d: 資料を送っていただけますか。
x: 〔Could you ~? は Can you ~? より丁寧。資料は documents / materials〕
p: {Could|Would|Can} you {please |}send me the {documents|document|materials|files|file|data}{| please}?
{Could|Would|Can} you {please |}send the {documents|document|materials|files|file} to me{| please}?
o: Would you send me the materials, please?

d: 遅れてすみません。
x: 〔Sorry I'm late. が一番自然。改まった場では I apologize for being late.〕
p: {Sorry|I'm sorry} {I'm|I am} late.
{Sorry|I'm sorry} for being late.
I apologize for being late.
o: I'm sorry for being late.

d: 今、少しお時間ありますか。
x: 〔話しかける前の定番。a minute は「ちょっとの時間」〕
p: Do you have {a minute|a moment|a second|a few minutes|some time|time}{| now| right now}?
{Have you got|Got} a {minute|moment|second}?
Are you free {now|right now|at the moment}?
o: Do you have a moment?
Got a minute?

d: 明日までに終わらせます。
x: 〔by は「〜までに」（期限）、until は「〜までずっと」。ここは by〕
p: {I'll|I will} {finish|complete} it by tomorrow.
{I'll|I will} {get it done|have it done|have it finished|have it ready} by tomorrow.
o: I'll have it done by tomorrow.

t: He's away from his desk right now.
d: 彼は今、席を外しています。
x: 〔電話の取次ぎの定番。at the moment は right now より少し丁寧〕
p: He's {away from his desk|not at his desk|out of the office|not in|out} {right now|at the moment|now}.
He {isn't|is not} at his desk {right now|at the moment|now}.
He's stepped away from his desk{| for a moment}.
o: He's not at his desk at the moment.

t: Who is in charge of this project?
d: このプロジェクトの担当は誰ですか。
x: 〔in charge of ～ で「～の担当で」〕
p: Who is {in charge of|responsible for|handling|running|leading|managing} this project?
o: Who is responsible for this project?

d: 来週の月曜日は空いていますか。
x: 〔next Monday には on をつけない。仕事では available がよく使われる〕
p: Are you {free|available} {next Monday|on Monday next week}?
Do you have time {next Monday|on Monday next week}?
o: Are you available next Monday?

d: それは良い考えですね。
x: 〔sounds like ~ で「～のように聞こえる」→ 相づちとして柔らかい〕
p: {That's|That is|That sounds like|Sounds like|It's|What} a {good|great|nice} idea.
o: That sounds like a great idea.

d: もう一度言っていただけますか。
x: 〔聞き返しの定番。Pardon? だけより丁寧で確実〕
p: {|Sorry, |Pardon me, |Excuse me, }{Could|Would|Can} you {please |}{say that again|repeat that|say it again}{| please}?
o: Sorry, could you repeat that?

d: 予算が足りません。
x: 〔enough は名詞の前（enough budget）、形容詞の後（big enough）〕
p: We {don't|do not} have enough {budget|money|funds}.
{The|Our} budget {isn't|is not} {enough|sufficient|big enough}.
We are short {of|on} {money|funds|budget}.
We {don't|do not} have a big enough budget.
o: The budget isn't enough.
We're short of funds.

t: Sales increased by 10% from last month.
d: 売上は先月より10%増えました。
x: 〔増減の幅は by。be up ～ は会話でよく使う言い方〕
p: Sales {increased|rose|went up|grew} {by |}{10%|10 percent|ten percent} {from|over|compared to|compared with|since} last month.
Sales {were|are} up {10%|10 percent|ten percent} {from|over|compared to|compared with} last month.
o: Sales were up 10% from last month.

d: 何か質問はありますか。
x: 〔疑問文なので some ではなく any。questions と複数形〕
p: {Do you have|Are there|Does anyone have|Do you all have} any questions?
Any questions?
o: Are there any questions?

d: この件について話し合いましょう。
x: 〔discuss は他動詞なので discuss about としない（Let's discuss about this issue. は誤り。talk about なら about が要る）〕
p: {Let's|Let us} {discuss|talk about|go over} this{| matter| issue| topic}.
o: Let's talk about this issue.

d: ご協力ありがとうございます。
x: 〔Thank you for + 名詞 / ~ing〕
p: {Thank you|Thanks} {so much |very much |}for your {cooperation|help|support}.
{Thank you|Thanks} for cooperating.
o: Thanks for your help.

d: 私の責任です。
x: 〔失敗をかぶるなら It's my fault. / That's on me.〕
p: {It's|That's|This is} {my fault|my responsibility|on me}.
I take {full |}responsibility{| for this| for it| for that}.
I'm responsible{| for this| for that}.
o: That's on me.
I take full responsibility.

d: 午後にお電話します。
x: 〔今日の午後なら this afternoon。in the afternoon は日が決まっていないとき〕
p: {I'll|I will} {call you|phone you|give you a call|call} {this afternoon|in the afternoon|later this afternoon}.
o: I'll give you a call this afternoon.

t: She works in the sales department.
d: 彼女は営業部で働いています。
x: 〔部署は in。会話では in sales だけで通じる〕
p: She works {in|for|at} {the sales department|sales|the sales division|the sales team}.
She's {in|on} {the sales department|sales|the sales team}.
o: She works in sales.

d: 締め切りはいつですか。
x: 〔due は「期限が来る」。When is it due? も定番〕
p: {When|What} is the deadline{| for this}?
When is {it|this} due?
o: When is it due?

d: 会議室を予約しておきました。
x: 〔完了したことは現在完了で。I booked（過去形）も正しく、特にアメリカ英語ではよく使う。過去形は「過去に予約した」という出来事、現在完了は「予約してある（今も取れている）」という今の状態に重心がある。book / reserve どちらも可〕
p: I {have |}{booked|reserved} {a|the} {meeting|conference} room{| for us| for the meeting}.
o: I've reserved the conference room.

d: 少し考えさせてください。
x: 〔Let me ~ で「～させて」。think it over は「じっくり考える」〕
p: {|Please }let me think {about it|it over|about it for a bit|about it a little|about it for a while}.
{I'd|I would} like {some|a little|a bit of} time to think {about it|it over}.
Give me {some time|a moment|a little time} to think{| about it| it over}.
o: Let me think it over.

t: I'll forward this email to Mr. Tanaka as well.
d: このメールは田中さんにも転送します。
x: 〔「転送する」は forward。「～にも」は as well / too / also。すぐ転送するつもりなら I'm forwarding ～ も可〕
p: {I'll|I will} {forward|send} this {email|e-mail|mail|message} to {Mr. Tanaka|Ms. Tanaka|Tanaka-san|Tanaka} {as well|too}.
{I'll|I will} also {forward|send} this {email|e-mail|message} to {Mr. Tanaka|Ms. Tanaka|Tanaka-san|Tanaka}.
{I'm|I am} forwarding this {email|e-mail|mail|message} to {Mr. Tanaka|Ms. Tanaka|Tanaka-san|Tanaka} {as well|too}.
o: I'll also forward this email to Ms. Tanaka.

d: 価格はいくらですか。
x: 〔price は high/low で表す。How much is the price? より What's the price? が自然〕
p: How much {does it cost|is it|is the price|does this cost|is this}?
What {is|'s} the {price|cost}{| of this| of it}?
What is the price{| of this| of it}?
o: What's the price?

t: I'm going to Osaka on a business trip.
d: 出張で大阪に行きます。
x: 〔「出張で」は on a business trip / on business〕
p: {I'm|I am} {going|traveling|travelling|heading|going to go} to Osaka {on a business trip|on business|for business|for work}.
{I'll|I will} {be going|go} to Osaka {on a business trip|on business|for business|for work}.
{I have|I've got} a business trip to Osaka.
o: I'm going to Osaka on business.

t: I don't think I can make it in time.
d: 間に合いそうにありません。
x: 〔make it は「間に合う・都合がつく」。英語では I don't think ~ と否定を前に出すのが自然〕
p: I {don't|do not} think {I can|I'll be able to|we can|we'll be able to} make it{| in time| on time}.
{I'm afraid|Unfortunately,|Unfortunately} {I|we} {can't|cannot|won't be able to} make it{| in time| on time}.
{I|We} might not {make it|be able to make it}{| in time| on time}.
o: I'm afraid I can't make it in time.

d: 何時がご都合よろしいですか。
x: 〔works for you は「あなたに都合がいい」。convenient は人ではなく時間が主語。What time are you OK with? も通じるがくだけた言い方〕
p: {What time|When} {works|is good|is convenient|would work|would be good|would be convenient|is best|would be best} for you?
What time {suits|would suit} you{| best}?
{What time|When} {are you|would you be} {OK|okay|fine|all right} with?
o: When would be convenient for you?

d: お手数をおかけしてすみません。
x: 〔改まった場では I apologize for the inconvenience.〕
p: {Sorry|I'm sorry|I apologize|We apologize} for {the trouble|the inconvenience|troubling you|any inconvenience|bothering you|any trouble}.
{Sorry|I'm sorry} to {trouble|bother} you.
o: I apologize for the inconvenience.

t: The new system is easy to use.
d: 新しいシステムは使いやすいです。
x: 〔easy to use の to use は「使うのに」。using にしない〕
p: The new system is {easy|simple} to use.
The new system is {user-friendly|user friendly}.
o: The new system is user-friendly.

t: A new manager will join us next month.
d: 来月から新しい部長が来ます。
x: 〔「来月から」は from next month でも通じるが、next month だけで十分〕
p: A new {manager|department head|director|general manager} {will join us|will join|will come|is coming|is joining us|is joining|will start|is starting} {next month|from next month|starting next month}.
{We will|We'll|We are going to|We're going to} have a new {manager|department head|director|general manager} {next month|from next month|starting next month}.
We're getting a new {manager|department head|director|general manager} {next month|starting next month}.
o: We'll have a new department head next month.

t: Could you let me know a few dates and times that work for you?
d: ご都合のよい日時をいくつかお知らせいただけますか。
x: 〔let me know ～ は「～を教えて」の万能表現。that work for you（関係詞）で「都合のよい」〕
p: {Could|Would|Can} you {please |}let me know {a few|some|several} {dates and times|times and dates|dates|times|options} that {work|would work|are convenient|would be convenient} for you?
{Could|Would|Can} you {please |}{give me|send me|suggest} {a few|some|several} {dates and times|times and dates|dates|times|options} that {work|would work|are convenient|would be convenient} for you?
o: Could you suggest a few times that would work for you?

d: 添付の資料をご確認ください。
x: 〔Please find attached ～ はメールの決まり文句〕
p: Please {check|review|see|take a look at|have a look at|look at|refer to} the attached {document|documents|file|files|materials}.
Please find {the document |the file |the materials |}attached.
Please find attached the {document|file|materials|documents|files}.
Attached {is|are} the {document|file|documents|files|materials}{| for your review}.
o: Please find attached the document.
Please review the attached file.

t: Just to make sure, let me confirm.
d: 念のため確認させてください。
x: 〔double-check は「再確認する」。念のため = just to be sure / just in case〕
p: {Just to make sure|Just to be sure|Just in case|To be on the safe side|Just to be safe}, {let me|I'd like to|I would like to|allow me to} {confirm|double-check|check}{| this| something| one thing}.
{Let me|I'd like to} {confirm|double-check|check}{| this| something| one thing} {just to be sure|just to make sure|just in case|to be safe}.
o: Let me double-check just to be sure.

t: We'll discuss it internally and get back to you.
d: その件は社内で検討して、改めてご連絡します。
x: 〔get back to you は「折り返し連絡する」。internally で「社内で」〕
p: {We'll|We will|I'll|I will} {discuss|consider|review|talk about} {it|this|the matter|that} internally and {get back to you|contact you again|let you know|follow up with you}{| later| soon| shortly}.
o: We'll review this internally and follow up with you.

t: I agree with this proposal, but I'm concerned about the cost.
d: この案には賛成ですが、コストが心配です。
x: 〔be concerned about ～ は worried より冷静な「懸念している」〕
p: I {agree with|support|am in favor of|am for|like} this {proposal|plan|idea}, but I'm {concerned|worried} about the {cost|costs}.
I {agree with|support} this {proposal|plan|idea}, but the {cost|costs} {concern|worry|worries|concerns} me.
o: I support this plan, but I'm worried about the costs.

t: I'm afraid we can't accept those terms.
d: 申し訳ありませんが、その条件はお受けできません。
x: 〔I'm afraid ～ で断りを柔らかく。契約の「条件」は terms〕
p: {I'm afraid|I'm sorry, but|I am sorry, but|Unfortunately,|We're sorry, but|I'm sorry but} we {can't|cannot|are unable to|aren't able to|won't be able to} accept {those|these|the|your} {terms|conditions}.
{I'm afraid|Unfortunately,} {those|these|the|your} {terms|conditions} {are not|aren't} acceptable{| to us}.
o: Unfortunately, we are unable to accept these conditions.

t: Would it be possible to extend the deadline by a week?
d: 納期を1週間延ばしていただくことは可能でしょうか。
x: 〔Would it be possible to ～? は最上級に丁寧な依頼。延ばす幅は by〕
p: {Would it be|Is it} possible to {extend|push back|postpone} the {deadline|delivery date|due date} by {a week|one week|1 week}?
{Could|Would|Can} you {extend|push back} the {deadline|delivery date|due date} by {a week|one week|1 week}?
Could we {extend|push back} the {deadline|delivery date|due date} by {a week|one week|1 week}?
o: Could you push back the deadline by one week?

t: Let me briefly summarize our last meeting.
d: 前回の打ち合わせの内容を簡単にまとめます。
x: 〔recap は summarize の口語。Let me ～ で会議を仕切る〕
p: {Let me|I'll|I will|I'd like to|I would like to} {briefly summarize|quickly summarize|summarize|give a brief summary of|give a quick summary of|recap|briefly recap|quickly recap|go over} {our|the} {last|previous} meeting.
o: Let me quickly recap the previous meeting.

t: To get straight to the point, we're postponing this plan.
d: 結論から申し上げますと、この計画は延期します。
x: 〔英語の会議は結論が先が基本。to get straight to the point / bottom line は前置きの定番〕
p: {To get straight to the point|To cut to the chase|In short|To put it simply|Bottom line|In conclusion|Let me start with the conclusion|Let me get straight to the point|To start with the conclusion}, {we're|we are} {postponing|delaying|putting off} this {plan|project}.

{To get straight to the point|To cut to the chase|In short|To put it simply|Bottom line|In conclusion|Let me start with the conclusion|Let me get straight to the point|To start with the conclusion}, {we'll|we will|we have decided to|we've decided to} {postpone|delay|put off} this {plan|project}.

{To get straight to the point|To cut to the chase|In short|To put it simply|Bottom line|In conclusion|Let me start with the conclusion|Let me get straight to the point|To start with the conclusion}, this {plan|project} {will be|is being|has been} {postponed|delayed|put off}.
o: In short, we've decided to postpone this plan.

t: Our strength is our quick response.
d: 弊社の強みは迅速な対応です。
x: 〔「弊社」は英語では our company / we で十分。turnaround は「対応の速さ・処理時間」〕
p: Our {strength|biggest strength|main strength|greatest strength|advantage|strong point|key strength} is {our |}{quick|fast|rapid|prompt|speedy} {response|responses|responsiveness|turnaround}.
{We're|We are} known for {our quick response|our quick responses|responding quickly|our fast response|our responsiveness}.
o: Our main strength is our fast turnaround.

t: I can't say for sure at this point.
d: 現時点では何とも言えません。
x: 〔at this point は「現時点で」。It's too early to say. もよく使う〕
p: {I|We} {can't|cannot} say {for sure |anything |}{at this point|at the moment|right now|yet|at this stage|for now}.
It's {hard|difficult|too early} to {say|tell}{| at this point| at the moment| right now| yet| at this stage}.
{I'm|We're} not sure {at this point|at the moment|yet|right now}.
o: It's too early to say.

t: I'll check with the person in charge on their side and get back to you.
d: 先方の担当者に確認してから折り返します。
x: 〔「先方」は their side / their company。check with ＋人 で「～に確認する」〕
p: {I'll|I will} {check with|confirm with|ask|talk to} {the person in charge on their side|their person in charge|the person in charge at their company|their contact person|their contact|the contact person on their side|their representative|the person in charge there} and {get back to you|call you back|let you know|follow up with you}.
o: I'll check with their contact person and call you back.

t: There's still room for negotiation on the price.
d: 価格についてはまだ交渉の余地があります。
x: 〔room は「余地」（数えない）。negotiable は「交渉可能な」〕
p: There's still room {for negotiation|to negotiate} {on|regarding|about|with} the price.
The price is still {negotiable|open to negotiation|open for negotiation}.
We can still negotiate {on |}the price.
o: The price is still negotiable.

t: We need to find the root cause of this problem.
d: この問題の根本的な原因を突き止める必要があります。
x: 〔root cause は「根本原因」の定番語。identify は「特定する」〕
p: We {need to|have to|must} {find|identify|figure out|get to|pinpoint|determine} the {root cause|underlying cause|fundamental cause|real cause} of this {problem|issue}.
o: We need to identify the underlying cause of this issue.

d: 誤解を招いたことをお詫び申し上げます。
x: 〔any misunderstanding で「（もしあれば）どんな誤解でも」と角を立てない〕
p: {I|We} {apologize|sincerely apologize} for {any misunderstanding|the misunderstanding|causing a misunderstanding|causing any misunderstanding|the confusion|any confusion|causing confusion|causing any confusion}.
{I'm|We're|I am|We are} {sorry|very sorry} for {any misunderstanding|the misunderstanding|causing a misunderstanding|the confusion|any confusion|causing confusion}.
o: We apologize for any confusion.

t: I look forward to continuing to work with you.
d: 引き続きよろしくお願いいたします。
x: 〔「よろしく」に当たる英語はないので、場面に合う気持ちを言う。continue to ～ の to は不定詞〕
p: {I|We} look forward to {continuing to work with you|working with you|our continued cooperation|continuing our work together|working together|working with you again}.
{I'm|We're} looking forward to {continuing to work with you|working with you|our continued cooperation|working together}.
Thank you for your continued support.
o: Thank you for your continued support.

t: Our goal for next term is to increase sales by 20%.
d: 来期の目標は売上を20%伸ばすことです。
x: 〔「来期」は next term / next fiscal year。伸び幅は by〕
p: Our {goal|target|objective|aim} for {next term|the next term|next year|the next fiscal year|next fiscal year|the next period|next period} is to {increase|grow|raise|boost} {sales|revenue|our sales} by {20%|20 percent|twenty percent}.
{We aim|We're aiming|Our goal is} to {increase|grow|raise|boost} {sales|revenue} by {20%|20 percent|twenty percent} {next term|next year|next fiscal year|in the next fiscal year}.
o: We aim to grow revenue by 20% next fiscal year.

t: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
d: ご不明な点があれば、遠慮なくお問い合わせください。
x: 〔feel free to ～「遠慮なく～して」、don't hesitate to ～ も同じ意味の定番〕
p: If you have any {questions|concerns}, {please |}{feel free|don't hesitate|do not hesitate} to {contact me|contact us|ask|reach out|let me know|get in touch|reach out to me|reach out to us}.
{Please |}{feel free|don't hesitate|do not hesitate} to {contact me|contact us|ask|reach out|let me know|get in touch} if you have any {questions|concerns}.
o: Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

t: This figure is down compared to the same period last year.
d: この数字は前年同期比で減少しています。
x: 〔前年同期比 = compared to the same period last year / year on year（YoY）〕
p: {This figure|This number|The figure|The number} {is down|has decreased|has declined|has fallen|has dropped|decreased|declined|fell|dropped|is lower} {compared to|compared with|from|versus|against} the same period {last year|of last year|a year ago}.
{This figure|This number|The figure} is {down|lower} year {on|over} year.
o: This figure is down year on year.

t: Let's find a solution that benefits both sides.
d: 双方にとって利益になる解決策を探しましょう。
x: 〔that benefits ～ は関係詞。win-win は英語でもそのまま通じる〕
p: {Let's|Let us} {find|look for|work out|seek|come up with} a {solution|resolution} that {benefits|works for|is good for|is beneficial for|is beneficial to} {both sides|both of us|both parties|everyone}.
{Let's|Let us} {find|look for|aim for|come up with} a win-win solution.
o: Let's look for a win-win solution.

d: 計画は予定通りに進んでいます。
x: 〔on schedule / on track は「予定通りに」の定番〕
p: {The plan|The project|Everything} is {on schedule|on track|going as planned|progressing as planned|proceeding as planned|moving forward as planned|going according to plan|progressing according to schedule}.
Things are {on schedule|on track|going as planned|going according to plan}.
o: The project is on track.

t: We'll give your proposal positive consideration.
d: ご提案いただいた件、前向きに検討いたします。
x: 〔「前向きに検討」は give ～ positive consideration。断りの婉曲表現と取られない言い方を選ぶ〕

x: 〔non-negotiable「交渉の余地なし」。compromise on ～「～で妥協する」〕
p: {That's|That is|This is} {non-negotiable|not negotiable} {for us|for me|}.
{We|I} {can't|cannot} {compromise|budge|give way|move} on {that|this|that point|this point}.
{That's|That is} {where we draw the line|a deal-breaker for us}.
o: We can't compromise on that point.

d: 中間を取りましょう。
x: 〔meet halfway / split the difference「歩み寄る・差額を折半する」〕
p: {Let's|Let us|Why don't we|Shall we|How about we} {meet halfway|meet in the middle|split the difference|find a middle ground|find some middle ground|compromise}{.|?}
o: Why don't we split the difference?

t: I'll take it back to my team and discuss it.
d: 社に持ち帰って検討します。
x: 〔即答を避ける定番。take ～ back to …〕
p: {I'll|I will|We'll|We will} {take it|take this|bring it|bring this} back to {my|our} {team|company|office|boss|management|colleagues} {and discuss it|to discuss|and talk it over|for discussion|and consider it}.
{I'll|I will|We'll|We will} {discuss|talk about|consider} {it|this} {internally|with my team|with our team|with my boss|with management} and {get back to you|let you know|follow up}.
o: I'll discuss this with my team and get back to you.

t: I have some concerns about that proposal.
d: その提案には懸念があります。
x: 〔反対を角立てずに言う。reservations「留保・ためらい」〕
p: I have {some |a few |}{concerns|reservations} about {that|this|the|your} {proposal|plan|suggestion|idea}.
{I'm|I am} {a bit |a little |somewhat |}{concerned|worried} about {that|this|the|your} {proposal|plan|suggestion|idea}.
o: I have some reservations about this plan.

t: Could you give us a concrete example?
d: 具体例を挙げていただけますか。
x: 〔concrete / specific「具体的な」〕
p: {Could|Would|Can} you {give us|give me|share|provide} {a concrete|a specific|an|a} example{| please}?
{Could|Can|Would} you be more specific{| please}?
{Do you have|Can you think of} {a concrete|a specific|an} example?
o: Could you be more specific?

t: So, to sum up, this is what we're saying.
d: 整理すると、こういうことですね。
x: 〔話をまとめる合図。to sum up / in short〕
p: {So, |So |}{to sum up|to summarize|in summary|in short|basically|in other words}, {this is what we're saying|this is what we are saying|this is the point|this is where we are|here's what we have|here is what we have}.
{So, |So |}{let me|let's} {sum up|summarize|recap}{| what we've said| what we have said| where we are}.
o: Let me sum up what we've said.

d: ご無理なさらないでください。
x: 〔Take it easy.「気楽にね」は別れぎわにも使う〕
p: Please {don't|do not} {overdo it|work too hard|push yourself too hard|push yourself too much|overwork yourself}.
{Don't|Do not} {overdo it|work too hard|push yourself too hard}.
Take it easy.
o: Take it easy.

t: I'll leave it up to you.
d: その件はお任せします。
x: 〔up to you「あなた次第」。your call も同じ〕
p: {I'll|I will} leave {it|that|this|the matter} {up to you|to you|in your hands}.
{It's|It is|That's|That is} {up to you|your call|your decision}.
{I|We} trust your judgment{| on this| on that}.
o: It's your call.

t: Please take a look when you have a moment.
d: お手すきの際にご確認ください。
x: 〔when you get a chance「時間があるときに」は急かさない定番〕
p: Please {take a look|have a look|check it|check this|look at it|review it} when{ever|} you {have a moment|have time|get a chance|have a minute|are free}.
{Could|Can} you {take a look|have a look|check it|review it} when you {have a moment|have time|get a chance}?
o: Please take a look when you get a chance.

t: I'll book a table for dinner.
d: 会食の席を予約しておきます。
x: 〔レストランの予約は book a table〕
p: {I'll|I will} {book|reserve|make a reservation for|get} a table for {dinner|our dinner|the dinner}.
{I'll|I will} make a {dinner |}reservation{| for dinner| for us}.
o: I'll make a dinner reservation.

t: Good morning. Let's have a good day.
d: おはようございます。今日もよろしくお願いします。
x: 〔「よろしくお願いします」に直訳はない。場面に合わせて言いかえるのがコツ〕
p: Good morning{.|!} {Let's have a good day|Let's do our best today|Let's make it a good day}{.|!}
o: Good morning! Let's do our best today.

d: もう一度説明していただけますか。
x: 〔Could you ~? は丁寧な依頼の基本形〕
p: {Could|Would|Can} you {please |}explain {that|it} again{| please}?
{Could|Would|Can} you {please |}explain {that|it} one more time{| please}?
o: Would you explain it one more time?

t: Can I ask you a question?
d: ちょっと質問してもいいですか。
x: 〔May I ~? がいちばん丁寧〕
p: {Can|May|Could} I ask {you |}a {question|quick question}?
o: May I ask a quick question?

d: 来週の水曜日はいかがですか。
x: 〔How about ~? は提案の定番。work for you は「都合がいい」〕
p: How about next Wednesday?
{Would|Does|Will} next Wednesday {work|work for you|be OK|be okay|be all right}?
What about next Wednesday?
o: Does next Wednesday work for you?

d: 資料は昨日送りました。
x: 〔資料は materials / documents。過去の時点（yesterday）があるので過去形〕
p: I sent {the|you the} {materials|documents|files|data} yesterday.
I sent {the|those} {materials|documents|files} to you yesterday.
o: I sent you the documents yesterday.

d: 会議は中止になりました。
x: 〔cancel は受け身で。call off も同じ意味。英国式綴りは cancelled〕
p: The meeting {has been|was|is} {canceled|cancelled|called off}.
o: The meeting was called off.

t: Could you send it by email?
d: メールで送っていただけますか。
x: 〔by email の by は手段。email は動詞としても使える〕
p: {Could|Would|Can} you {please |}{send|email} {it|that|them}{ to me|}{ by email| via email|}{| please}?
o: Could you email it to me?

d: 後でかけ直します。
x: 〔call back で「折り返し電話する」〕
p: {I'll|I will} call {you |}back later.
{I'll|I will} call you again later.
o: I'll call back later.

d: 始めましょう。
x: 〔会議の第一声。get started は自然な口語〕
p: Let's {get started|start|begin}{| now}{.|!}
Shall we {get started|start|begin}?
o: Shall we begin?

d: 手伝いましょうか。
x: 〔Shall I ~? は「〜しましょうか」の申し出〕
p: {Can|May|Shall} I help {you|}{| with that}?
Do you need {any |some |}help{| with that}?
Let me help {you|}{| with that}.
o: Do you need any help?

t: How long does it take to get to the station by taxi?
d: 駅までタクシーでどのくらいかかりますか。
x: 〔時間は How long、料金なら How much〕
p: How long does it take {to get |to go |}to the station by taxi?
How long {is|will} the taxi {ride |}to the station {take|be}?
How long is the taxi ride to the station?
o: How long is the taxi ride to the station?

t: Good work today. See you tomorrow.
d: お疲れさまでした。また明日。
x: 〔「お疲れさま」も直訳なし。労いか、See you で足りる〕
p: {Good work|Great work|Thanks for your hard work|Thank you for your hard work}{| today}. See you tomorrow{.|!}
o: Thanks for your hard work today. See you tomorrow.
